ValidationRule.description: If Service Range Type = “Fix Range” or “Variable range volume pricing”, then the 2 fields “What” and “Quantity Unit of Measure” are mandatory.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), OR(ISPICKVAL(ER_Service_Range_Type__c, 'Range with Fix Price'), ISPICKVAL(ER_Service_Range_Type__c, 'Range with Variable price Volume pricing')), OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(ER_What__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(QuantityUnitOfMeasure))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: VRER03 - If Service Range Type = “Fix Range” or “Variable range volume pricing”, then “What” and “Quantity Unit of Measure” are mandatory.
